en: A vintage black-and-white postcard with a decorative border and the large word 'Varėna' at the top. The postcard features five smaller photographs: a sanatorium, a monument (likely a war memorial), a municipal/government building, a starch factory, and a cardboard factory. The layout is symmetrical, with folk-art motifs on the sides. There is Lithuanian text labeling each image, and the name of the photographer (D. Gordano) and location (Varėna) in the bottom right corner.
